paragraphs: InfraHub sells road management software, with a pavement survey that applies ASTM D6433 standards to identify distresses and calculate Pavement Condition Index from 0-100. Asset inventories cover roadside asset mapping and condition assessment, with 20+ asset types available, from stop signs to guardrails, sidewalks, and bike lanes. The road management platform provides tools for end-to-end management of maintenance workflows, including planning and job creation tools and a work management system for tracking project progress.

Data collection uses 360-degree cameras that gather image, GPS, and telemetry data along a road network. Images are processed by AI models that create inventories by identifying and assessing pavement distresses and road assets. Data from the cloud is surfaced in a web application where users can view, edit, and manage their road network. Generated data can be exported in formats including shapefiles and Excel files, and imported into any GIS software.

The pages name State DOTs, City and County DOTs, Municipal DOTs, DPWs, and MPOs, Civil Engineering Firms, and Regional TPOs as the groups served. Pricing is based on a per-mile rate tailored to the set of assets and distresses a customer needs identified. A 1,000-mile road network is typically processed within one month.
